description: Shapley shares of the crude log-RR, with and without the configuration block
population: CRSS police-reported crashes 2016-2024 with a determinable NHTSA-imputed maximum severity (MAXSEV_IM 0-4)
method: Survey logistic models for every subset of 7 covariate blocks (exact cell compression); standardised RR/RD over all crashes by g-computation; joint Taylor linearisation on the 25-stratum/67-PSU design (t, 42 df); Shapley shares exact over all orderings
